findingDetails.title: The partner-side offer field is computed and then dropped by both offer writers
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg -n "offeredAs" shows parseOffer/replayOffer/failedOffer as the only producers and offerOf as the only consumer; both write paths select fields without it; the backfill test stub returns no offeredAs.
findingDetails.claim: The partner-side offer marker is added by parseOffer/replayOffer but is not copied into any run line by either producer, so the scorer partner-side exclusion never fires on a real log.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched every runtime file for another writer of offeredAs (none); checked whether the runner spreads the replay object (it selects two fields); checked whether the scorer can infer the partner side from offeredCommand alone (the same string can be head or partner); checked the backfill test stub (no offeredAs).
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The field could be intended only for the scorer unit tests and a future producer, in which case the README claim and the scorer read are the defects rather than the writers.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If every run log is normalized to add offeredAs before scoring, or the scorer derives the partner side from a stored head, this becomes a P2 documentation cleanup.

findingDetails.title: A heredoc whose delimiter is not a bare identifier is read as commands
findingDetails.scopeProof: HEREDOC_BODY is the only heredoc filter and shellReadTargets its only consumer; no test uses a delimiter outside the identifier grammar.

findingDetails.title: A shell read counts as a workflow load but not as a start or a loop
findingDetails.scopeProof: readDocument is the single start/loop detector; the new shell readers feed only followedBeforeWrite and ownerLoadedBeforeWrite; no test combines a shell read with startState or takenLoop.
